body:
**What you must know:** `kit.py brief` and adopt's own write path are deleted (they rebuilt `resume` and `artifact load/push`). What remains changes existing scripts: `docs/CL28.md § Changes to existing scripts` lists each, the roles and runtimes.

## Resume
Now also lists each open question (age, default, what it blocks), your decisions of the last 3 days, and a stale `_orchestrator` id.

## The guard
The orchestrator's reply to your comment is refused unless `kit.py resume` ran in that session in the last 15 min.

## Command index
`kit.py commands [word]`, read before any code (part prompt step 1b, session start), in every runtime.

## Memory
Where things stand is the board only; memory keeps lessons, the workflow, preferences, timers.

## Idea: decisions distilled into principles (your question)
`principles.md` in memory, one line each: the rule, your words quoted, the comment id and date, its scope (a train or all). Guardrails: only from your own words, never a session's guess; you confirm each with a Like; at most 30 lines; a new one that contradicts an old one replaces it, both ids kept; a train's principles archive when it is done. `resume` prints them, so old comments need not be reread.
